answers.sql: SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM reserve_components WHERE report_date = '2025-03-31';
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN measure = 'total supply' THEN amount_usdc ELSE -amount_usdc END) FROM circulation_inputs WHERE report_date = '2025-03-31';
SELECT (SELECT reported_total_usd FROM reported_reserve_totals WHERE report_date = '2025-03-31') - SUM(amount_usd) FROM reserve_components WHERE report_date = '2025-03-31';

WITH r31 AS (SELECT SUM(amount_usd) AS val FROM reserve_components WHERE report_date = '2025-03-31'), c31 AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN measure = 'total supply' THEN amount_usdc ELSE -amount_usdc END) AS val FROM circulation_inputs WHERE report_date = '2025-03-31'), r19 AS (SELECT SUM(amount_usd) AS val FROM reserve_components WHERE report_date = '2025-03-19'), c19 AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN measure = 'total supply' THEN amount_usdc ELSE -amount_usdc END) AS val FROM circulation_inputs WHERE report_date = '2025-03-19') SELECT (CAST((SELECT val FROM r31) AS REAL) / (SELECT val FROM c31) - CAST((SELECT val FROM r19) AS REAL) / (SELECT val FROM c19)) * 10000;
